name: Glassmorphism
description: Frosted glass effect with blur transparency border
implementation: backdrop-filter: blur(12px); background: rgba(255255255 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255255255 0.2); border-radius: 16px
use_cases: SaaS dashboards AI tools fintech dark mode apps
do_examples: Use on dark backgrounds with depth layers behind glass
dont_examples: Use on white/light backgrounds glass disappears

name: Neumorphism
description: Soft extruded surface shadows pushed/pulled look
use_cases: Minimal apps wellness calculators simple UIs
do_examples: Works on single mid-tone bg color soft shadows
dont_examples: Don't use on dark bg or bright colors fails entirely

name: Dark Mode Editorial
description: High-contrast dark background light text cinematic
implementation: background: #0A0A0F; color: #F8FAFC; accent: vibrant neon or gold; font: bold geometric
use_cases: AI tools dev tools gaming crypto analytics
do_examples: Full commitment to dark palette vivid accent
dont_examples: Mixing dark/light sections without clear purpose

name: Brutalism
description: Raw unpolished intentional awkwardness high contrast
implementation: No border-radius heavy borders primary colors Arial/Helvetica system fonts 0 padding
use_cases: Creative agencies portfolio sites counter-culture brands
dont_examples: Accidental bad design vs intentional brutalism

name: Minimalism
description: Extreme white space single focus typography-led
implementation: >70% white space single accent color max 2 fonts generous line height
do_examples: One hero element everything else serves it
dont_examples: Minimalism excuse for lack of content or design

name: Bento Grid
description: Card-based asymmetric grid varied card sizes
implementation: CSS Grid with span-2 span-3 varying heights 8px gap border-radius: 16px
use_cases: Feature showcases SaaS landing pages portfolios
do_examples: Mix card sizes for visual rhythm consistent border radius
dont_examples: All equal-size cards defeats the purpose

name: Scroll Storytelling
description: Content revealed on scroll timeline narrative
implementation: IntersectionObserver fade-slide-in on scroll fixed hero scroll-driven animation
use_cases: Brand stories product launches campaign pages
do_examples: Each scroll reveal adds meaningful information
dont_examples: Animations for their own sake no content purpose

name: Aurora / Gradient Mesh
description: Organic color gradient backgrounds animated subtle
implementation: CSS: radial-gradient(ellipse) mesh-gradient tool multiple overlapping soft gradients animate via CSS vars
use_cases: AI products SaaS hero sections tech brands 2024-2025
do_examples: Subtle movement muted pastels or deep neons
dont_examples: Overly saturated neon rainbow epilepsy risk

name: Kinetic Typography
description: Text as the primary hero animation
implementation: GSAP or Framer Motion letter/word split animate on scroll large bold display font
use_cases: Agencies studios launches campaigns bold brands
do_examples: Short punchy text motion serves the message

name: 3D / Depth
implementation: Three.js Spline or Lottie embedded 3D CSS perspective transform on cards
use_cases: Product showcases landing pages tech hardware
dont_examples: Heavy 3D that kills page speed LCP >4s fails Core Web Vitals
